Shyin ki jappé, li pa mòrd.
The dog that yelps doesn't bite.
Loud threats rarely come to anything.

Shyin pa manjé shyin.
Dogs don't eat dogs.
People of a kind stick together.

Kapon viv lontem.
The coward lives a long time.
Caution keeps you alive.

Çila ki ri vendrèdi va plœré dìmansh.
Whoever laughs on Friday will cry on Sunday.
Joy too early can turn to tears.

Dolo toujou kouri larivyær.
Water always runs to the river.
Things go where they belong.

Maringwin pèrdi sô tem kan li piké kokodri.
The mosquito wastes its time stinging the alligator.
Don't waste effort on the untouchable.

Mærsi pa kouté ariyin.
Thanks cost nothing.
Gratitude is free.

Piti a piti, zwazo fé sô nik.
Little by little, the bird builds its nest.
Patience gets things done.

Lapli tombé, wawaron shanté.
The rain falls, the bullfrogs sing.
Everything has its season.

Lake sha pousé avek tem.
The cat's tail grows with time.
Some things can't be hurried.

Tou jou çé pa dìmansh.
Every day isn't Sunday.
Good times don't last forever.

Tou makak trouv sô piti-yé joli.
Every monkey thinks her children are pretty.
Love sees beauty in its own.

Koupé zòrèy milé fé pa shval.
Cutting a mule's ears doesn't make it a horse.
You can't change what something is.

Kan patat kwit, fo manjé li.
When the sweet potato is cooked, you have to eat it.
Act when the time is right.

Rat manjé kann, lézar mouri inosan.
The rat eats the cane, the lizard dies innocent.
The wrong one often pays.

Bon-tem fé krapo manké bounda.
Good times leave the toad with no backside.
Idleness costs you in the end.

Di mò ki to lenmé, m'a di twa ki to yé.
Tell me who you love, I'll tell you who you are.
You are known by the people you love.

Éyou gin charogn, gin karankro.
Where there's carrion, there are buzzards.
Trouble draws those who feed on it.

Mo va pa prété twa baton pou kasé mô latèt.
I won't lend you a stick to break my head.
Don't arm the person who would harm you.

Tafya toujou di la verité.
Tafia always tells the truth.
Drink loosens the tongue.

Pran gard vo myè pasé mandé pardon.
Taking care is better than asking pardon.
Better safe than sorry.

Ça va rivé dan la smènn kat jedi.
That will happen in the week with four Thursdays.
It will never happen.

Fo pa maré tayo avek sosis.
Don't tie up the hound with sausages.
Don't tempt someone with what they crave.
